textAnnotations.description:
Ingredients / douvainou:
WATER ETHYLHEXYL METHOXYCINNAMATE ALCOHOL DENATURED, CYCLOPENTABLOWANE DETHYLAMANO HYDROXYBENGOVE
HEXYL BENZOATE, BENZOPHENONE & MEXYLDECYL MYRISTOYL METHYLAMINOPROPIONATE, METHYLSILANOL
MANNUFIONATE GLYCERIN BUTYLENE GLYCOL GAFFYLYL METHICONE TITANIUM DIONICE METHYLENE BE BENAUTRIAZOLYE
TETRAMETHYL BUTYLPHENOL DIMETHICONE, OCTYLDODECYL OLMATE PEG 40 GLYCERYL STEARATE ANTEMIA
EXTRACT, OCTYLDODECANOL, ECHIUM PLANTAGINEUM SEED OIL, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED OIL UNSAPONIFIABLES,
CARDIOSPERMUM HALICACABUM FLOWER/LEAF/VINE EXTRACT, TOCOPHEROL, ONOTHIAZOLIDINE LECITHIN,
BOHENADEDANE, INC POA POLYGLYCERYL-10 DOSTEARATE POLYGLYCERYL-10 LAURATE CETYL ETHYLHEXANDATE
GLYCERYL ISOSTEARATE, LAURETH-23 PENTAERYTHRITYL DISTEARATE, ORYZA SATIVA (FCE) BRAN WAX DEXTRIN
PALMITATE, SODIUM CHLORIDE, PHYTANTRIOL, SODIUM HYALURONATE PANTHENOL TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, ALOE
BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, BODIUM POLYACRYLATE, ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALICYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER
PHYTOSTERYL/OCTYLDODECYL LAUROYL GLUTAMATE POTASSIUM HYDROSIDE, XANTHAN GUAL DISODIUM EDTA
BHT, BOSTEARIC ACID, PHENOXYETHANOL, METHYLPARABEN, ETHYLPARABEN, PROPYLPARABEN
